title: Switzerland Couple Escape
headline: Lucerne, a high alpine day, then Interlaken or a lake town.
description: Six nights for two: three by Lake Lucerne, three in the Bernese Oberland, with one mountain excursion as quoted.
image_alt: The Matterhorn above an alpine village in Switzerland
price_label: Quoted for your hotels and rail
price_guidance: Switzerland pricing depends on hotel category, Swiss Travel Pass versus point-to-point tickets, and which mountain — Titlis, Jungfraujoch or Schilthorn. We confirm a written total before you reserve.
overview: A couple’s alpine week with two stays. Lucerne for the lake and old town; Interlaken or a nearby village for high peaks. Trains, not coaches. One mountain day is included as quoted; the rest can stay empty.
highlights: Three nights in Lucerne with a lake evening.
Rail between cities on a pass or tickets we specify.
Three nights in Interlaken or a neighbouring village.
One mountain excursion — peak confirmed in writing.
why: Two bases, not a hotel every night.
Vegetarian dining is planned town by town.
Schengen visa guidance for Indian passports, timed to your tickets.
inclusions: Airport transfer or rail from the arrival city as quoted
One mountain excursion as specified in your quote
exclusions: Second mountain peaks, lake cruises and cable cars unless added
Personal expenses, GST and tourism fees

amenities: Rail tickets or pass as quoted

notes: Peak choice, rail pass and hotels are confirmed only after you approve the written quote. High alpine routes depend on weather and seasonal closures. An inquiry is not a booking.
